notes: Ack discipline + delivery diagnostics (2026-09-03a, 'Doris silent-200') — 6 days of forensic data (2026-08-28→09-03) proved Doris's iPad received ok-looking saveAnalytics 200s while NOTHING persisted server-side, and the client drained its persisted queue on that lie, silently eating every exercise/session event. Server: saveAnalytics now returns per-event addedEventIds/duplicateEventIds acks and writes a best-effort delivery_diagnostics doc (delivery_diag_saveAnalytics) per accepted request — the only server-side trace of whether fetch-path flushes physically reach the function. Client: flushAnalytics clears the persisted queue ONLY when the response accounts for every shipped eventId (added or duplicate); silent/partial 200s keep the queue so the proven sendBeacon path re-ships it (server eventId de-dup keeps that idempotent). Server-side pure helper applyEventsWithAck unit-tested; client ack paths covered in test_session_flush_deadline.js (full-ack drains / silent-200 keeps queue + restores SR / partial-ack keeps queue).
